lines.text: Nokia began in 1865 at a Finnish timber mill. Paper was only the beginning.
Nokia expanded beyond paper into rubber boots, cables, and electricity, helping Finland modernize before mobile phones arrived.
When the digital age arrived, Nokia pivoted once more—redefining mobile phones and connecting people around the world.
